name: ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping
xsql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    pos_input.master_position_id AS master_position_id,
    pa_active.region AS region
FROM xactly.xc_period per 
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos_input
    ON pos_input.master_position_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
    /* Date check ensures we are looking at the active position version record */
    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos_input.effective_start_date AS DATE)
    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos_input.effective_end_date AS DATE)
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
    ON pos_input.position_id = ppa.position_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_base
    ON ppa.participant_id = pa_base.participant_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
    ON pa_base.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
    /* Date check isolates the active participant version record */
    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
